mapper.sql: select e.id, n.namespace_code as namespace_code, n.namespace_name as namespace_name, e.message_key as message_key, e.default_message as default_message, e.source_locale as source_locale, e.source_type as source_type, e.source_ref as source_ref, e.status, case when coalesce(t_target.translated_message, t_fallback.translated_message, '') <> '' then 'TRANSLATED' else 'PENDING' end as translation_status, coalesce(t_target.translated_message, t_fallback.translated_message, '') as current_translation, coalesce(u.usage_count, 0) as usage_count, e.created_at as created_at, e.updated_at as updated_at
mapper.select: from sys_localization_entry e join sys_localization_namespace n on n.id = e.namespace_id and n.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t_target on t_target.entry_id = e.id and t_target.locale_code = #{targetLocale} and t_target.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t_fallback on t_fallback.entry_id = e.id and t_fallback.locale_code = #{fallbackLocale} and t_fallback.deleted = 0 left join ( select entry_id, count(1) as usage_count from sys_localization_usage_ref where deleted = 0 group by entry_id ) u on u.entry_id = e.id where e.id = #{entryId} and e.deleted = 0 limit 1

select e.message_key as message_key, e.default_message as default_message, t_target.translated_message as target_message, t_fallback.translated_message as fallback_message from sys_localization_entry e join sys_localization_namespace n on n.id = e.namespace_id and n.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t_target on t_target.entry_id = e.id and t_target.locale_code = #{targetLocale} and t_target.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t_fallback on t_fallback.entry_id = e.id and t_fallback.locale_code = #{fallbackLocale} and t_fallback.deleted = 0 where e.deleted = 0 and e.status = 'ENABLED' order by n.sort_no asc, e.id asc

select count(1) from sys_localization_entry e left join sys_localization_translation t on t.entry_id = e.id and t.locale_code = #{localeCode} and t.deleted = 0 where e.deleted = 0 and coalesce(t.translated_message, '') <> ''

select l.locale_code as localeCode, coalesce(t.translated_count, 0) as translatedCount, coalesce(r.published_version, 0) as publishedVersion, r.lastPublishedAt as lastPublishedAt from sys_localization_language l left join ( select t.locale_code as locale_code, count(1) as translated_count from sys_localization_translation t join sys_localization_entry e on e.id = t.entry_id and e.deleted = 0 where t.deleted = 0 and coalesce(t.translated_message, '') <> '' group by t.locale_code ) t on t.locale_code = l.locale_code left join ( select locale_code, max(release_version) as published_version, max(published_at) as lastPublishedAt from sys_localization_release where deleted = 0 and active_flag = 1 group by locale_code ) r on r.locale_code = l.locale_code where l.deleted = 0 order by l.is_default desc, l.sort_no asc, l.id asc
select count(1) from sys_localization_entry e join sys_localization_namespace n on n.id = e.namespace_id and n.deleted = 0 where e.deleted = 0 and n.namespace_code = #{namespaceCode}

select count(1) from sys_localization_entry e join sys_localization_namespace n on n.id = e.namespace_id and n.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t on t.entry_id = e.id and t.locale_code = #{localeCode} and t.deleted = 0 where e.deleted = 0 and n.namespace_code = #{namespaceCode} and coalesce(t.translated_message, '') <> ''

select n.namespace_code as namespaceCode, count(1) as entryCount, sum(case when coalesce(t.translated_message, '') <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as translatedCount from sys_localization_entry e join sys_localization_namespace n on n.id = e.namespace_id and n.deleted = 0 left join sys_localization_translation t on t.entry_id = e.id and t.locale_code = #{localeCode} and t.deleted = 0 where e.deleted = 0 group by n.namespace_code order by min(n.sort_no) asc, min(n.id) asc, n.namespace_code asc
